faq.description: Video Claw is designed to help you learn faster from long videos without pretending the source no longer matters.

items.question: What is Video Claw?
items.answer: Video Claw is a searchable learning interface for long videos. It helps you search transcripts, find exact moments, jump back to the source, and ask AI follow-up questions.

items.question: Is this just another AI video summarizer?
items.answer: No. The product is designed around keyword search, timestamp navigation, and transcript-grounded Q&A rather than a one-shot generic summary.

items.question: What kinds of videos work best?
items.answer: The best fit is long-form knowledge content such as interviews, lectures, podcasts, webinars, and idea-dense YouTube videos.

items.question: Can I verify where an answer came from?
items.answer: Yes. The goal is to keep answers tied to transcript matches and exact moments so you can jump back to the original source.

items.question: Why does the homepage send me to the workspace?
items.answer: The homepage is intentionally lightweight. Its main job is to get you from a video link to the learning workspace as quickly as possible.
